common_assumptions: file paths exist at expected locations without prior verification
CLI tools and build systems are installed and functional
network services and remote hosts are reachable
prior session state reflects current disk/repo state
test environments start clean with no residual state
strength_patterns: systematic before/after verification via test runs and output checks
progressive refinement through iterative tool calls rather than single large edits
multi-source information gathering before modifying production paths
weakness_patterns: high rate of zero-step or single-step chains indicating missed context or premature termination
repetitive near-identical tool calls without strategy change when blocked
thinking steps are rare relative to chain length, suggesting reactive rather than deliberate planning
